frames.title: Saw timber
frames.description: Front-right, sawing a short timber across two stout wooden sawhorses with a hand saw, one hand steadying wood. Curly copper hair, freckled broad face, compact ginger fan beard, cream sleeves, brown vest, green trousers.

frames.title: Build timber crate
frames.description: Front-left, hammering nails into a timber crate on a low bench, other hand bracing the corner.

frames.title: Stack firewood
frames.description: Right-side, stacking split firewood neatly into a short timber rack, two pieces held in both arms.

frames.title: Haul firewood
frames.description: Rear-left, hauling a small wooden sled loaded with firewood using a rope held in both hands, whole sled and rope fit cell.

frames.title: Sharpen hatchet
frames.description: Front-right, seated on a low stool sharpening a hatchet on a whetstone atop a compact bench, hatchet held safely.

frames.title: Carry supplies
frames.description: Front-left, carrying a sack of supplies over one shoulder and a small bucket in the free hand, full body and props visible.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
